title: heliconia subulata subsp. gracilis
intro: Heliconia subulata subsp. gracilis, commonly known as Red Heliconia, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Heliconiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, colds, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Heliconia subulata subsp. gracilis include its ability to reduce pain, lower inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
